population_note: primary population = labelled dev pairs (tier) called by the caller; not-called labelled pairs are excluded and enter only the end-to-end analysis

ident_ens_mean.description: Ensembl-style identity, mean of min and max

ident_x_cov.description: local identity (max over orientations) x min coverage of the two proteins

end_to_end.note: caller-missed pairs scored at the minimum (one tie block) for every method, B1 included; a caller-independent direct alignment for B1 (statistics R2 item 5) is not implemented yet
